units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 22:9">Targ. Y. Gen. XXII, 9</cite>.
Targ. Ps. CXVIII, 27; a. e.—Part. pass. pl. כְּפוּתִין (hebr.) put in stocks.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 21:29">Targ. Y. II, Num. XXI, 29</cite>.—
<cite ref="Tamid 31b:26">Tam. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>דכַפְתֵיה בשיראי</he> if one tied the sacrifice (hands and feet) with silk ropes.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 167a:7">B. Bath. 167ᵃ</cite> <he>כפתיה ואודי</he> he put him in stocks (or in prison), and he confessed.
<cite ref="Gittin 14a:2">Gitt. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>דכַפְתֵי ושקלי וכ׳</he> who use force (have him arrested) and collect their due immediately (allowing no time).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:5:6">Y. Gitt. I, end, 43ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:4:7">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ</cite> <he>כַּפְתוּן ואפקון מיניה</he> they put him in stocks and forced him to pay; a. e.—[<cite ref="Gittin 62a:8">Gitt. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>מִכְפַּת וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01748"><he>אִכְפַּת</he></cite>.]
Targ. Cant. VII, 5.—Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ דהוא מְכַפֵּת ביה he (the weaver) uses it for tying (or knotting, v. infra).

senses.gloss: (v. P. Sm. 1803) to produce knots, to mature fruits.
